text.tspan: fitted on the header, jumpers shorted
Active-low: pin LOW energises the relay.
Contacts are isolated from the coil side.
• Waterproof DS18B20 leads: red = VDD (3.3 V), yellow = DQ (data), black = GND.
• One 4.7 kΩ pull-up (R1) for the whole bus, at TB1 where the four data wires meet.
• The relay board plugs onto the header; the lines above are its header connections.
• Wires that cross without a dot are not connected.
